# nemau load-balancer certificate import

Import a certificate and its private key from PEM files.

--certificate holds the leaf, optionally followed by its chain (a fullchain.pem);
--chain adds intermediates kept in a separate file. The key must not be
passphrase-protected. Accepted keys: RSA 2048 to 4096 bits, ECDSA P-256 and
P-384.

## Usage

```
nemau load-balancer certificate import [flags]
```

Alias: `create`

## Options

```
      --certificate string   PEM file with the certificate, optionally followed by its chain (required)
      --chain string         PEM file with intermediate certificates
      --name string          certificate name, unique in the project (required)
      --private-key string   PEM file with the unencrypted private key (required)
```

## Global options

```
      --api-url string           API origin (default: $NEMAU_API_URL, then https://api.nemau-cloud.com)
      --idempotency-key string   key making a write safe to repeat: 1-128 characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : - (default: generated)
  -o, --output string            output format: table, json (default "table")
      --project string           target project, by id or by name (default: $NEMAU_PROJECT_ID, then the saved project)
  -q, --quiet                    print ids only
      --timeout duration         how long to wait for one operation (default 30m0s)
      --wait                     wait for asynchronous operations to finish (default true)
```
